events.title: Tupac Shakur's Passing
events.blurb: On this day in 1996, influential rapper Tupac Shakur was shot dead in a drive-by shooting in Las Vegas at the age of 25. He would have been 55 this year.

angles.name: Remembering a Legend
angles.copy: Reflecting on the enduring legacy of Tupac Shakur, who left us far too soon. His impact on music and culture remains undeniable.

events.title: Jimi Hendrix's Passing
events.blurb: Legendary guitarist Jimi Hendrix died in London on this day in 1970, aged just 27. He would have been 84 this year.

angles.name: Guitar God Remembered
angles.copy: Remembering the unparalleled genius of Jimi Hendrix, who redefined the electric guitar and left an indelible mark on music.

events.title: Abbey Road Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic album 'Abbey Road' in the UK on this day in 1969, featuring the legendary zebra crossing cover.

angles.name: Iconic Album Turns 57
angles.copy: 57 years since The Beatles gave us 'Abbey Road'. What's your favourite track from this timeless masterpiece?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Happy 75th Birthday to Chrissie Hynde, the iconic lead singer and songwriter of The Pretenders, born on this day in 1951.

angles.name: Pretenders Frontwoman's Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 75th birthday to the incredible Chrissie Hynde! Her voice and style are still as powerful as ever.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Liam Gallagher, the unmistakable voice of Oasis and a formidable solo artist, celebrates his 54th birthday today, born in 1972.

angles.name: Rock 'n' Roll Star's Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 54th Birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! Still bringing the swagger and the tunes. What's your favourite Liam track?

events.title: Imagine Single Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic single 'Imagine' was first released in the UK on this day in 1975 to promote the compilation album 'Shaved Fish'.

angles.name: A Song For Peace
angles.copy: 49 years since John Lennon's 'Imagine' single hit the UK. Its message of peace and unity resonates just as strongly today.

events.title: iPod Launch Anniversary
events.blurb: Apple unveiled the first-generation iPod on this day in 2001, revolutionising how we carry and listen to music.

angles.name: 25 Years of the iPod
angles.copy: Remember the first time you put 1,000 songs in your pocket? Today marks 25 years since Apple unveiled the original iPod!

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: Today marks James Bond Day, celebrating the release of the very first 007 film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Shaken, Not Stirred
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! Which Bond actor is your favourite, and what's the ultimate 007 theme tune?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Remembering John Lennon, who would have celebrated his 86th birthday today. The legendary Beatle was born on this day in 1940.

angles.name: A Timeless Visionary
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we honour the life and music of John Lennon. His songs continue to inspire generations.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Happy 87th Birthday to the legendary British comedian, actor, and writer John Cleese, born on this day in 1939.

angles.name: Comedy Legend's Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, a true British institution.

events.title: White Album Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', on this day in 1968.

angles.name: The Eclectic Masterpiece
angles.copy: 58 years of 'The White Album'! A sprawling, diverse, and often experimental record that showcased The Beatles at their most creative.

events.title: Freddie Mercury's Passing
events.blurb: We remember the legendary Queen frontman Freddie Mercury, who passed away on this day in 1991 at the age of 45. He would have been 80 this year.

angles.name: Remembering a Rock Icon
angles.copy: His voice, his stage presence, his legacy. Remembering the one and only Freddie Mercury on the anniversary of his passing.

events.title: Rubber Soul Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' in the UK on this day in 1965, marking a significant artistic shift.

angles.name: A Soulful Evolution
angles.copy: 61 years since The Beatles unveiled 'Rubber Soul'. This album was a game-changer, showcasing their evolving sound and songwriting.

events.title: John Lennon's Passing
events.blurb: On this day in 1980, the world lost a musical icon, John Lennon, who was tragically killed at the age of 40. He would have been 86 this year.

angles.name: Remembering a Legend
angles.copy: 46 years since we lost John Lennon. His music and message of peace continue to resonate globally. Always remembered.
